description: Machine Learning-Based Dispatch Optimization of a Molten-Salt Concentrating Solar Power Plant Using Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Miguel Ortega, Miguel Angel Reyes Belmonte (Universidad Rey Juan Carlos). This dataset contains the electricity-market, gas-market, power-system and economic time series used to develop and benchmark the end-to-end dispatch-optimization algorithm presented in the associated article, which couples a deep neural network for day-ahead electricity price forecasting with a genetic algorithm for revenue-maximizing thermal energy storage (TES) dispatch in a molten-salt parabolic-trough concentrating solar power plant ... Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
